name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council wrapped up early, so how about we take a quick look around the shopping district on our way back?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, does that mean we're finally adding something new to the dinner menu?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you feel like eating, Paqy?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you keep saying shameless things like that, people are gonna hate you」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anything's fine as long as it ain't curry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Too bad, though. We're not buying anything. Just window shopping」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Betraying even the expectations of your loyal servant--truly worthy of the Demon Lord」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm so disappointed, the great me is gonna sulk and go to sleep...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, thank you so much for today!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm looking forward to working with you starting tomorrow!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Haven't seen you since yesterday! What are you up to?」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I'd take a quick look around the shopping district before heading home」

name: Macaron
message: 「Guess what, starting tomorrow, they're letting me work right here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, at Uncle Amakawa's place? Good for you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah... big brother. You totally thought I just took the bait because of the milk, didn't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I didn't think that at all」

name: Macaron
message: 「You thought I was just some gluttonous little kid!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aww man, my feelings are totally hurt~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, that makes sense! You don't look smart enough to pull off lying to someone anyway!」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I'm being teased here, though」
She pokes my cheek with her index finger.

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm~? Your face is all red, you know~?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're just embarrassed from getting teased, aren't you!」
If anything, the unguarded physical affection is what makes me feel self-conscious.
The giant kitchen knife Macaron had strapped to her back grazes right past the tip of my nose!

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm way grander than that! Don't call me something that sounds like small fry!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa, got it, so put that kitchen knife away! That's dangerous!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's not a kitchen knife! It's the demon greatsword Alzard!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Make sure you remember it properly. Good grief...」
I wonder if it's some kind of rare kitchen knife...

name: Synn
message: 「To celebrate landing your part-time job, I'll give you this」

name: Macaron
message: 「The old man already gave me one earlier」
The two of us pop the caps off together.
Looks like Macaron and I are going to get along well after all.

name: Synn
message: 「You're already a full-fledged resident of Ryuusei Town too, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Do you think I can become popular enough to win everyone's hearts?」
When it comes down to it, Macaron really is a good kid.

name: Synn
message: 「Once again, it's great to have you with us」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. Let's be good friends, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alriiight! Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna work even harder!」

name: Macaron
message: 「So with that said, I'm gonna go for a quick run to get pumped up!」
How should I put it--she's like a pure ball of energy.

name: Synn
message: 「I should really learn from that side of her...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm...? Felt like I sensed a familiar presence again...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm getting hungry, so shall we head back?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I feel like I haven't properly thanked Big Brother yet...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll ask Uncle where Big Brother is tomorrow.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Always paying back what I owe is the Macaron way!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll stick to your teachings and definitely become someone great!」
